title: Look Taller in 10 Seconds
cut_style: pixel-art stickers, retro 8-bit video game look
voice: Friendly, clear, brisk narrator, about 170 WPM.

cuts.tall_stance: Simple flat pixel-art paper sticker of a person standing tall with a confident upright posture, no text or symbols.
cuts.head_hips_stack: Retro 8-bit paper cutout of a side-view body silhouette with head stacked above hips, connected by a straight vertical guide line, no text or numbers.
cuts.shoulders_back_down: Pixel-art sticker of upper torso with shoulders guided by curved arrows moving back and downward, no letters or numbers.
cuts.level_chin: Flat 8-bit paper cutout of a calm face in side view with chin level and eyes looking forward, no text.
cuts.balanced_feet: Pixel-art sticker of two feet planted evenly on the floor with equal balance marks, no text or numbers.

scenes.vo: Want to look taller in 10 seconds?
First, stack your head over your hips.
Roll shoulders back, then gently drop them down.
Keep chin level and eyes straight ahead.
Balance both feet; reset before every photo.
